trusted_external_entities.name: Transaction Submitter
trusted_external_entities.rationale: User or application submitting transactions via JSON-RPC or P2P gossip. No authentication required for transaction submission, full validation of transaction format and signature required.

trusted_external_entities.name: Transaction Signer
trusted_external_entities.rationale: User or wallet application signing transactions. While signature proves key ownership, the signer's intent and transaction content must be fully validated. Wallets may be compromised or malicious.

trusted_external_entities.name: Network Peer
trusted_external_entities.rationale: P2P network peer submitting blocks for validation. Network peers are untrusted by default; full block validation including header, ommers, transactions, and root hashes required.

trusted_external_entities.name: Transaction Sender
trusted_external_entities.rationale: External account that signed and submitted transactions. Signature verification confirms key ownership but sender content and intent are untrusted.

trusted_external_entities.name: Block Miner
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Miner producing blocks with proof-of-work. PoW verification proves computational work but does not verify block content correctness. Full validation required.

trusted_external_entities.name: Beacon Deposit Contract
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Fixed address contract (0x00000000219ab540356cbb839cbe05303d7705fa) with known verified bytecode. Contract address and event signature are authenticated, but deposit data structure must still be validated against expected format.

trusted_external_entities.name: Consensus Layer
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Beacon chain receiving and processing deposit requests. Communication typically authenticated via Engine API JWT, but request data from execution layer must still be validated by consensus layer.

boundary_edges.security_assumption: Full transaction type detection and validation required. First byte determines typed vs legacy format. Invalid transactions must be rejected.
Transaction content must be fully validated after signature verification. Type byte must be included in signed data for domain separation to prevent cross-type signature reuse.
Full block validation required: header validation, ommer validation, transaction execution, and root hash verification. InvalidBlock exception raised on any validation failure.
Transaction validation required: gas available in block, nonce match, balance sufficient for gas*price + value, sender is EOA.
PoW verification required via hashimoto_light. Mix digest must match computed value. Result must be <= MAX_VALUE / difficulty.

Deposit event data must be exactly 576 bytes with validated offsets and sizes. Contract address and event signature provide authentication, but data format must be strictly validated. InvalidBlock on malformed data.
Requests are committed via SHA256 hash in block header. Consensus layer authenticates via Engine API JWT but must independently validate request contents.
